releaseNotes: v1.2.0: Track current app (optional, off by default). Turn it on in the app and each Apple TV reports which app is playing (currentApp, currentAppId, playbackState, title, artist, duration), using the existing pairing, no new PIN. It adds three hidden helper devices per Apple TV; turning it off removes them. Also: the device page shows the model name (Apple TV 4K (1st gen)) with the raw ID kept as modelId, the Version updates on its own after an update, new TVs whose name already says Apple TV skip the "Apple TV - " prefix, and a corrected connection status logs as info instead of a warning. Beta testers: remove Apple TV Now Playing (Beta) before turning on Track current app. v1.1.5 to v1.1.7: Fixes an Apple TV showing "connecting" after a hub reboot or firmware update. v1.1.4: Dark mode.
author: jdthomas24
tags: Apple TV, TV, video, local control

apps.name: Apple TV Integration
apps.description: Finds Apple TVs on your network, pairs each with the PIN shown on the TV and creates one device per Apple TV.

drivers.name: Apple TV
drivers.description: One per Apple TV. On/off with live power state, playback controls, Siri Remote buttons (including the TV button), volume, app launching, now playing and, optionally, the current app, over an encrypted local connection.

drivers.name: Apple TV Helper
drivers.description: Hidden helper devices for Track current app (three per Apple TV, created and removed by the Apple TV device). Holds the AirPlay connections that report which app is playing.
